shared_response_contract: contentText markdown or plain text; promptTokens/completionTokens optional
provider_specific_response_notes: choice path and usage path may vary slightly by vendor
default_retry_policy: retry timeout/network once; no retry on deterministic 4xx
adapter_test_scope: backend registry + worker fake + one real provider smoke
acceptance_checklist: provider appears in admin; model can bind to TEXT_GENERATION tool; task SUCCESS/FAILED settles credits; markdown renders
notes: 同协议文本模型优先复用一套 client/handler，只新增 provider registry 和模型配置

shared_response_contract: contentJson/images[] with url, sourceUrl, width, height; resourceType=IMAGE
provider_specific_response_notes: some providers return base64, some URL, some async task id
default_retry_policy: retry before provider accepts request; do not duplicate accepted async generation
adapter_test_scope: worker fake image test + generated URL smoke
acceptance_checklist: tool can submit prompt/count/aspectRatio; generated images persist to /generated/images; gallery renders; failure releases frozen credits
notes: 文生图模型通常可复用同一个 IMAGE_GENERATION handler，差异集中在 provider client/adapter 和 response parser

shared_response_contract: contentJson/images[] with edited image URLs; resourceType=IMAGE
provider_specific_response_notes: requires upload or base64 input handling
default_retry_policy: retry upload separately; no duplicate generation after provider job id exists
adapter_test_scope: file upload + worker fake + result render
acceptance_checklist: supports image upload; mask optional; generated result persists; original assets are not leaked
notes: 如果只是文生图不要混入这类；图生图/局部重绘参数差异大，建议单独分类

shared_response_contract: contentText answer; optional structured JSON extraction
provider_specific_response_notes: image payload shape differs across OpenAI-compatible vendors
billable_units_rule: image tokens + text tokens if provider returns usage
default_retry_policy: retry timeout/network; validate image URL before model call
acceptance_checklist: image input field works; worker sends image to model; result text renders
notes: 视觉理解可以复用文本 handler，但表单、文件读取和 message 构造要单独适配

shared_response_contract: contentJson/audios[] with url, contentType, duration optional; resourceType=AUDIO
provider_specific_response_notes: sync/async and voice id formats vary heavily
billable_units_rule: billableUnits = 1 or character count depending provider
default_retry_policy: poll async providers; retry poll only after create succeeds
adapter_test_scope: worker TTS unit + generated audio URL smoke
acceptance_checklist: audio file persists; browser player works; provider error marks FAILED
notes: TTS 共享 handler 没问题，但 client 内要按 provider 分支处理同步/异步

shared_response_contract: contentJson/tracks[] with url, lyrics, duration, coverUrl optional; resourceType=AUDIO
provider_specific_response_notes: copyright metadata and async job status differ
default_retry_policy: async create+poll; no duplicate create after job id
adapter_test_scope: new handler fake + generated track URL smoke
acceptance_checklist: music metadata renders; audio plays; copyright notes captured
notes: 不要和 TTS 混在一个 ToolType；同为 AUDIO 输出但业务语义不同

shared_response_contract: contentJson/videos[] with url, coverUrl, duration; resourceType=VIDEO
provider_specific_response_notes: usually async; status enums vary by provider
default_retry_policy: poll async job; retry poll; no duplicate generation
acceptance_checklist: video persists; player renders; progress visible; timeout reconciler works
notes: 视频生成可共用 handler，但 provider client/轮询/结果解析差异会比文生图大

shared_response_contract: contentJson/videos[] plus intermediate asset metadata; resourceType=VIDEO

default_retry_policy: checkpoint intermediate assets; retry only failed stage when safe
